payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the deep learning methods used for hate speech detection, including the architectures and their applications.

claims.text: The deep learning methods investigated include Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTMs), and FastText.
CNNs outperformed LSTMs, which in turn outperformed FastText in the hate speech detection task.
Deep learning methods significantly improved accuracy in hate speech detection compared to traditional methods.
